  (ρ : Representation.{0, 0, 0} Complex (Etingof.Problem4_12_2.Heisenberg p) (ZMod p → Complex)),
  (∀ (f : ZMod p → Complex) (t : ZMod p),
      Eq.{1} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} ρ (Etingof.Problem4_12_2.Heisenberg.xGen p)) f t)
        (f (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} t 1))) →
    (∀ (f : ZMod p → Complex) (t : ZMod p),
        Eq.{1} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} ρ (Etingof.Problem4_12_2.Heisenberg.yGen p)) f t)
          (f t)) →
      Exists.{1} fun S =>
        And
          (∀ (i : Fin p) (g : Etingof.Problem4_12_2.Heisenberg p) (v : ZMod p → Complex),
            Membership.mem.{0, 0} (S i) v →
              Membership.mem.{0, 0} (S i) (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} ρ g) v))
          (And
            (∀ (i : Fin p),
              Eq.{1} (Module.finrank.{0, 0} Complex (Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} (S i) x)) 1)
            (And (DirectSum.IsInternal.{0, 0, 0} S)
              (Exists.{1} fun χ =>
                And (Function.Injective.{1, 1} χ)
                  (∀ (i : Fin p) (g : Etingof.Problem4_12_2.Heisenberg p) (w : ZMod p → Complex),
                    Membership.mem.{0, 0} (S i) w →
                      Eq.{1} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} ρ g) w)
                        (HSMul.hSMul.{0, 0, 0} (Units.val.{0} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (χ i) g)) w)))))
